newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound remains stable against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound remains stable against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was stable to fractionally weaker against the dollar on Tuesday in the private sector interbank market, bankers said.
"The market is still liquid, but we don't expect any big changes now," one banker said.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3875 and 3.3885 pounds bid, and at between 3.3895 and 3.3905 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Tuesday was 3.3880 pounds bid and 3.390125 pounds offered in the interbank market, compared to 3.38775 pounds bid and 3.3894 pounds offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386713 pounds buy and 3.3920896 pounds sell.
